name: Quarantine policies
description: Lists quarantine policies with what end users may do with quarantined messages, whether quarantine notifications are sent and, optionally, the global notification settings.

parameters.name: IncludeGlobalSettings
parameters.label: Include global notification settings
parameters.help: Also read the organisation's global quarantine notification settings, such as how often notifications are sent.

prerequisites: ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later installed through your organisation's approved process, and an Exchange or Microsoft Defender role that can read threat policies, such as Security Reader.
limitations: Runtime support follows the ExchangeOnlineManagement module's documented support; not yet tested in a tenant.

End-user permissions are decoded from the returned value using the bit order Microsoft documents; the decoding has not been confirmed in a tenant. A value not returned, or not a number from 0 to 255, is not decoded.
AccessPreset names a preset only when the value equals it (NoAccess 0, LimitedAccess 27, FullAccess 23); any other value is Custom.
Which protection policies use each quarantine policy is not read here; the protection policies item does not list them either.
A true or false value Exchange did not return is shown as Unknown, never as False.
The roles listed follow Microsoft's documentation and have not been confirmed in a tenant.
